units.source_text: 薰中纳言写信给宇治的女公子，其中有这样的话：“……当然须至贵处泊宿，务请先做准备。

en.t: Kaoru the Middle Counselor wrote to the young ladies of Uji, and in the letter he said this: "...Of course I shall have to spend the night at your residence, so please make preparations in advance.

units.source_text: 前年同来看花诸人，此次亦乘机前来，或将借避雨之名造府。

en.t: The people who came with me the year before last to view the blossoms will also take this opportunity to come, and they may visit your house under the pretext of sheltering from the rain.
Please do not let your lovely forms be seen by others..."
The letter explained the matter in great detail.

units.source_text: 宇治山庄中便更换帷帘，打扫各处，清除积集在岩石间而朽腐了的红叶，又除去蔓生在池塘中的水草。

en.t: At the mountain villa in Uji, the curtains were changed, every place was swept clean, the rotted red leaves that had gathered among the rocks were cleared away, and the water grasses spreading through the pond were removed.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言派人送来许多佳美的果物和肴馔，又遣送几名相当的服役人员。

en.t: Kaoru the Middle Counselor sent people with many fine fruits and delicacies, and also dispatched several suitable attendants.

units.source_text: 两女公子觉得不好意思，然而无可奈何，只得认为这也是前世注定之事，便接受了他的惠赠而静候贵客光临。

en.t: The two young ladies felt embarrassed, but since there was nothing they could do, they decided this too must have been destined from a former life, accepted his generous gifts, and quietly awaited the arrival of their noble guests.
